review_description: After briefing, receiving written proposals and evaluating five local Solar PV + battery installers, we chose Oslec Energy as our preferred option. My wife and I have not regretted this decision.Three of the criteria in our written and verbal brief was our insistence on someone coming to do a site visit at our home and not solely reply on satellite imagery to determine our individual requirement. Another important criteria was for an installer understanding our intent, system performance expectation and our power needs into the future. The final criteria was being able to supply and install quality kit within our reasonable budget.On all counts, Oslec Energy met these. Their personable Managing Director conducted the site visit, after having first read our written brief. He evaluated our shading issues, roof area and location for the inverter and storage battery. He went off and designed and priced a system specifically for us and our location. We now have a solar PV / storage battery system correctly specced and adequately sized for our current (semi-retirement) and future needs (full retirement) which now is a fully electric household including our BEV.The install team were friendly, efficient, professional, respectful, polite and did a neat install. On commissioning the set up, to be expected, there were a few early teething issues. With the help of Oslec, each were resolved. We now have a 13.2kW PV, 10kW inverter and 20kWh storage battery system working well for us.We have confidence in Oslec Energy being there into the future to support us should any issue or warranty claim arise. We could have purchased a similar system for less from other vendors, but as the old adage states - long after the price is forgotten, the quality remains. If you are looking to install a new or upgrade an existing system, we recommend you consider Oslec Energy as one of your options at least.

Oslec provide a great service and great price.  They were prompt with the quotes and also the install time. Everything was left clean and tidy with all labelling in place. Jaryd and Simon are great guys willing to explain how things work and always there if you have any questions after installation.

During the sales process, Jaryd from Oslec was patient and guided us through the different options available. He provided us with a range of solutions suited to our needs, all at competitive prices.The installation was on a really hot day but the Oslec team cracked on, keeping their good humour under the most gruelling conditions. The end result is great - both the solar panels and inverter meticulously installed.After sales service kept up the standard. We were given documentation on use and maintenance, and are able to access the portal for our plant status on our phones and laptop. As we work from home that means we maximise our benefits by timing our use of high use appliances like washers, dryers etc for when our system is producing maximum power. The GoodWe inverter hasn't missed a beat, and the Aiko panels cope with shady conditions better than I expected.Overall, Oslec Energy exceeded expectations. It was an exceptional experience - would definitely recommend this company.

I recently had a solar and battery system installed at my home by OSLEC Energy, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. Jaryd and his team were absolutely fantastic — professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely committed to helping me find the right solution for my needs. Their attention to detail and customer care really stood out. If you’re considering solar or battery storage, I highly recommend OSLEC Energy for quality service and expert advice.

We had our old 2010 system replaced by Oslec. Jaryd ran through the options with us in person and explained the pros and cons about replacing our existing inverter vs upgrading the system. We ended up investing in a new system as we had already re invested in a new inverter in 2018.Installation went smoothly. Alex and James were polite and cleaned up after themselves which was nice.I am very curious for me first energy bill with the new system.

The Oslec team were amazing. Jayrd listened and understood exactly what I wanted in a system. He was knowledgable about the Solar Quotes recommended hardware, and offered 4 options with no sales pressure, just a good geeky chat about the possibilities. Simon performed the on-site inspection and did a great job explaining the battery and inverter placement options and wiring paths. He let know where they might need to make holes (and the options for patching), and other challenges they might run into during install. The install itself took 3 days, and Alex and the guys were tidy, polite, and punctual, with great communication throughout.

An outstanding end to end experience! From sharing knowledge, to guidance of understanding the process and not overselling what wouldn’t be needed for our business / personal needs. The installation process was exceptional - great communication, hardworking and polite tradesmen who took the time to explain and ensure everything was 100%.Any new opportunities to install solar I will be coming back here to Oslec Energy.

Used oslec energy to put solar panels up. From quote to finished installation was easy and stress free. Minimal disruption and tidy . The price was great and after sales service is exceptional. Would highly recommend

The sales/quoting experience was aided with an on-site visit which other quotes didn't offer. It was a close decision with other installers but this along with being local made us choose Oslec.The install was done well considering it was a warm day and tiresome work. We are still booking in a time to go through the system and how to monitor it.

Fantastic experience from which we should benefit greatlythe equipment used was fully explained to me in regard to  pros / consthe timing was as per all discussions with JarydInstallers were knowable and good tradies.

Jaryd was very easy to deal with and was very honest with his advice. He also put us in touch with finance providers.The installation went smoothly and Jaryd organised the connection to the grid so we didn't need to do anything. The system works great. Highly recommend Oslec Energy to anyone looking for a solar system!

Jaryd and Oslec energy are always great to deal with. The quoting process was simple and easy especially as this was for a new build. They made the process of adding solar to our house and easy process taking away any concerns we had.  Through the install process they were professional on site and explained what they were completing on each day. They left the site tidy when finished.
Great prompt and professional service. Extremely happy with the neatness of the installation work and very happy with all aspects of the customer service provided

Jaryd came around inspected the problem i had , Got back in touch with me the next day with three options no pressure what so ever. The installation was done over a 2 day period, Fast and very tidy didn't have to lift a finger. They even helped me get rid of the old equipment best part was no rush with payment As i was already connected to the grid with previous system i had no hassle with reconnection.

The process for quoting and explaining what we needed and what would suit us was great.The installation went smoothly and without a hitch. The team were polite and responded well to any questions.Customer service was great with organising a smart meter and advice on various power providers. They also visited after the installs to ensure all of the system was working well.

Jaryd the owner and operator understood what I was try to achieve with panels.i was replacing older and smaller system that no longer met my changing needs. Oslec will periodically monitor the system over the coming months to confirm the system is performing to agreed specifications. I have found the online monitoring app to be informative and easy to use.
Overall they did an excellant job polite tidy punctual they helped with the grid connection.could have been a little bit better cleaning up on the roof when they finished

They attended my property during the build to quote on time and very knowledgeable. I had the quote within the timeframe promised.The installation was faultless and on time. Old style tradesmen.They contacted me after the installation to make sure I was happy. In the quotation pack was all the information I needed to arrange the grid connection. When I had issues with my electricity supplier they supported me through the process.

Jaryd was great to deal with, he visited our home witch not everyone who quoted offered.We are 8 months in and very happy with our savings so far. It was hard to gauge the value for money portion of this review until now but I can certainly click the 5 star for this.Very happy with our solar system.

Both suppliers suggested by solar quotes were great. Very informative and no high pressure sell. Both sold high quality products.  It was difficult to decide between the two but in the end it came down to price

Jaryd was very polite and a good communicator. He gave us informed and realistic expectations.The installers did a good job.  At the end of a long day for the installers no doubt - we were left a bit uncertain about how to connect with the Inverter thru an app on our mobiles we needed to download as well as the process of contacting our energy retailer to request installation of the isolation switch and the provision of a new meter.Jaryd filled us in on that later (the intsallation was on a Friday and he wasn't so well on that Friday either). When we were contacted by our energy provider, they attended and told us they would not be installing their new meter (or the isolator for that matter) because of "cotton covered" mains.This means we have had to contact our own electrician to install the DV isolator which is added expense to us because the electricians from Origin Energy said "they won't touch it".All that was unknown and would have been good to know before the event - an inspection of the power board and a warning that it was going to get complicated.Still - we're happy with the job and the service !!ThanksArieta and Lloyd

Highly recommend Oslec for solar.They helped me  understand what the best system for me was and quoted me a great price. Communication was fantastic throughout the whole process. Installation was done in one day, the team was very friendly and they cleaned up after themselves. They organised the grid connection too. Extremely happy with Oslec.

The Oslec team were punctual, reliable and honest about the solar process which can feel a bit overwhelming. I was impressed with the initial quoting and integrity of Jaryd who sold me only what I needed and didn’t try and sell me more.The installation was excellent, they were on time and polite. They removed the old system for no extra cost (something the other companies charged for).Once installed Jaryd was great at teaching me about the system and how to use it, getting me on the App and answering any questions I had. Even now after a month they are responsive to questions. They’ve been with me every step of the way.The whole process has been fun, informative and friendly!!
Went extremely well from start to install.Jaryd gave us all the necessary information to help with our final decision.Installers were punctual, respectful and left the site clean.

It is evident that Finn from SolarQuotes is a subject matter expert and his communication of solar systems to the lay person on his website is exceptional (trust me, communicating complex science in a simplified but accurate message to the lay person is a skill in itself). Moreover, his independent and unbiased vetting of solar systems and installers only benefits the consumer. I had 3 quotes for installation of a 6.6 kW system and all seemed to be highly competent with the products recommended by SolarQuotes but could only choose one for supply and installation. Also, SolarQuotes were excellent in providing additional and timely analysis and advice of solar plans from suppliers when I submitted for their independent analysis and recommendation. I chose Oslec Energy in Adelaide for the job. Jaryd, Simon and the Oslec Energy team (all qualified solar installers) were exceptional in face-face discussion of my solar needs with critical appraisal of the size and system needed based on historical electricity usage. The team were very professional in installation and spent the time to explain the process and data portal post commissioning. The team were excellent to have around the house during installation. I highly recommend Oslec Energy for supply of solar systems in Adelaide. Moreover, it is proof-of-concept that Finn and the SolarQuotes team vet and recommend reputable companies for supply and installation of quality solar systems. Their approach and business model ensures that rogue installers are eliminated from the market and the most competent solar suppliers and installers provide the best service to the client. Well done SolarQuotes (Finn and team) and Oslec Energy (Jaryd, Simon and team).
Service was second to none, install was done ahead of time, value of the system is outstanding and we’re already getting better results than we expected and we haven’t had many warm sunny days yet.

We just built a house and wanted a 6.6kw system installed before we moved in. We got a few quotes and decided with Oslec based on the personal service and custom design, we felt we weren't just a number.Highly recommend, installation went smoothly and looking forward to our first electricity bill :)

Receiving a quote from Oslec Solar was a very easy process. I spoke to Jaryd in their shop on Semaphore Road and received an email the same day I spoke to him with lots of information about the solar panels and the pricing. The quote also included a plan for the panels on our roof.The team who came to install the system were very friendly and polite. They arrived on time and got straight on with the job. They left no mess, explained everything before they left, and answered any questions I had.Oslec organised the grid connection, and that happened about two weeks after the installation.I cannot recommend them highly enough, as the whole process was completely painless.I love the app I have on my phone now that shows what is happening with the solar - it is very helpful.If you are looking for solar in SA, definitely contact Oslec Energy.

Oslec stock and install only realy quality products, and you can tell that the quality flows through their whole business. Beginning to end it was a pleasure dealing with them.The quote documents they use are outstanding - showing all the ways i can save money and different energy comparisons. Then from quote to install, communication was great so i knew exactly what to expect and when. It seemed like nothing was too much trouble. A really great group of guys.I honestly didnt have to do a thing, the team took care of everything - so no need to organise anything after the install -it was all done for me.To sum it up - they provide a quality, value for money product combined with an excellent customer experience from beginning to end.

I had a 9kW solar system with energy monitoring installed by Oslec Energy last year, and I couldn't be happier with the entire experience. From the very beginning, Jaryd, the sales consultant and system designer, took the time to understand my energy needs and provided me with a range of suitable options. He did an excellent job of explaining the benefits of each and helping me choose the perfect system suited to my needs and property context without overselling. His professionalism, knowledge, and attention to detail gave me confidence in my decision.The installation process was smooth and hassle-free, thanks to the team led by Simon. They were punctual, efficient, and demonstrated exceptional workmanship throughout. The installers took great care to ensure a neat and high-quality job, even going the extra mile to conceal any visible cabling. When they finished, they left my property in immaculate condition, making sure to clean up any debris or waste from the installation.Since the system was installed, the energy generation has exceeded both the original estimate and my expected electricity bill reduction, which I believe is due to the split array design suggested by Jaryd which stretches total generation across more of the day. I have been delighted with the performance of my solar system, which is a testament to the quality of the products and the expertise of the Oslec Energy team.I highly recommend Oslec Energy for anyone looking to invest in solar for their home. The customer service, professionalism, and commitment to delivering a high-quality product have truly impressed me. I am confident that anyone who chooses Oslec Energy for their solar needs will be just as satisfied as I am.

Jaryd made the effort to come out to my house, discuss options and tailor a system suited to my preferences. Excellent service.Oslec's in-house installation team were professional, prompt and completed the job on-time.

I wasn't even planning on getting solar but having breakfast on Semaphore road a few months back I noticed Oslec Energy and took a flyer. Spoke with Jaryd who then ran us through how the system could benefit us. We felt very comfortable with Jaryd and the infomration provided. After the initial consult we did some searching and found the SolarQuotes website which also gave us the same information that Jaryd did.Installation was quick and the guys were very neat.Long story short we are very happy with the outcome and after talking with our friends we got a great deal!

From start to finish these guys were fantastic. Their communication was top notch and they explained everything to me simply and with the detail i required. The whole process was simple and easy - when we were at the installation phase they were at my house when they said they would be, and the job was completed without delays. They also cleaned up and left my house as though they had never been there! Really good guys.

Jarrad from Oslec solar, right from the get go was super helpful, from selecting the best solar package (12kw) for our needs to the final commissioning of the solar array.The Oslec solar installers were friendly and efficient, the electrician very helpful in understanding the workings of the system.The best thing was the credit we now receive from our power supplier rather than paying them a large bill.I highly recommend Oslec Solar
An easy process. Very professional and the installers left the site clean.The Fronius app with the smart meter is also a great addition. A live energy flow is very helpful.

The sales/quoting process was comprehensive, efficient and appropriate. Technical information was provided as required for information and to help with decision making.  The company representative was very well informed and attentive to my requirements without 'over selling'. I did not feel there was any pressure to purchase, it was my decision based on my requirements.The installation was efficient and trades person's working on the job were punctual and hard working, as well as tidy and respectful of my home and its surroundings.The customer service was well informed, responsive, respectful and polite, with efftiveafter sales service provided in terms of maintaining grid connection and responding to queries about subsequent billing.

I have used Oslec Energy for the installation of my Solar Systems on the last three houses that I have purchased.  I have found their professionalism and competitive pricing to be unsurpassed.  The installation of the solar system has been of the the highest quality.  The installation crew ensures that as a customer any inconvenience I may experience is minimalized.  The after instal  follow up was really appreciated.  I have recommend Oslec Energy to several of my friends and they have been very pleased with the service and installation.  I would recommend Oslec Energy to anyone who is considering installing a Solar system to their residence.

We initially looked into solar a few years ago but didn't go ahead then as we were confused with all of the information and conflicting information.We decided to look back into it after getting a large energy bill. After contacting Oslec and Jaryd talked us through the process and answered all of the concerns we had previously, I felt very comfortable with the process at Oslec, the team were honest, polite and patient with us as we had more questions than most I think.Install went smoothly, Simon and the team left the site looking like they were never there, apart from the solar system of course.Highly recommend.

Jaryd and the team were wonderful from the start of the consultation till the end of the installation right through the whole process and I highly recommend OSLEC Energy. Honest and reliable and answered my questions in a timely manner knowledgeable and not pushy

Oslec Energy were standouts in the quoting process. They provided the information I was after upfront in a timely way and were highly responsive throughout the process. I appreciated their candour and advice when discussing the best solar package to suit our needs now and into the future.Installation was painless, with the team arriving promptly, minimal disruption to my day, and they left the area clean and tidy. The panels look great on my roof!Customer support is ongoing due to external delays in getting my meter updated and reporting back on generation/usage but I have high confidence that the system is doing what it needs to do currently and most importantly that I will receive timely and responsive support if that is not the case.

Great work, thanks Jaryd and Simon, impressive turnaround, competitive price and fully documented with the correct paperwork and permissions. Price included extra powerpoints (3) and two new lights in garage. Well done, really professional service.

The process from start to finish was super smooth and easy. Jaryd was fantastic to deal with. He answered all my questions (no matter how silly they were) and worked with me to provide a system that was best for me and my property. The whole team were great to deal with and installation was done quickly.

Simple and easy, from the initial quote to installation Jaryd was easy to deal with and explained things to us in a way that was easy to understand.Installation was fast and completed in a day. Simon and the team were very polite and cleaned up after themselves.

Fantastic price that was super quick to quote with no hidden costs.The installation team were friendly, quick and very good at communicating what their movements were.Overall the service provided was exceptional, highly recommended.No photos shared because there are no panels visible from street level.Great job Oslec Energy!

Thanks to SolarQuotes for providing us with three excellent companies to deal with and quote on upgrading our 10 year old + 2.3 kW system.The standout was OSLEC Energy and we were impressed that it was actually the Managing Director of the small company that came out to see us, whereas the other two opted to provide quotes using NearMap in the first instance.Jaryd from OSLEC Energy is a qualified Electrician and actually designs and installs systems.  To us, this clearly gave him  a considerable edge over the other two sales people, when explaining things and answering our questions.After meeting with Jaryd he provided us quotes on budget, medium and high end systems and explained the pro's and con's of each one.  He actually talked us out of the biggest system and installing a battery at this time and we opted for a 9.75 kW system.We were happy to wait a month for the installation which commenced as planned and the installers were here at the arranged time.  They stopped slightly earlier than planned on the first day, due to weather, but had already removed the old system and done a lot of the on roof work before finishing.It had been planned as a two day installation but the following day (a Friday) was forecast to be wet.  Rather than tie up the installers for Friday and the likelihood of them being unable to work, we were happy to have the job finished on the following Monday.Monday saw the job completed and the three installers tidied up everything before leaving.There was no need to organize the grid connection because we already had panels and a smart meter installed.  They demonstrated the inverter, shut down procedure etc.The icing on the cake was the first full day after the installation.  On a winter's day with some cloud we produced 33 kWH, compared to the day before the installation when we produced only 1 kWH!We highly recommend the professionalism of this small business.
From wo to go. Jaryd and Simon made the whole process of quoting and installation of Solar easy. I appreciated their professionalism and response to my myriad of questions.
Exceelent service. Able to meet our budget. Able to install at our difficult to get to and unusual roof space.

Jaryd met with me early in the quote development process and provided patient and professional responses to all my solar system queries. Simon also addressed my installation concerns. This level of engagement gave me confidence that I would get a solar system installed to a high standard that met my needs.The installation process progressed in a quiet methodical manner over a two-day period. System handover and grid connection was also smooth.Overall this was a very satisfying experience – one that I will happily repeat when I get a home battery installed in a year or two's time.

I am so happy that Jaryd and Oslec were referred to me.  From the moment I met Jaryd, everything has been on time, smooth and totally efficient.  So much was taken out of my hands.  And the guys that installed the panels were brilliant.  Friendly but committed to the job. They were also very good to my princess poodle.  :)  :)  I can not recommend this crew highly enough.

I noted immediately that there was no pressure from the gentleman who came to quote the installation for me.  He spent considerable time with me explaining everything that would take place if I chose to go ahead.. The installation was done within a week.  All the workmen were punctual, polite and left nothing (bar the panels) to show they had even been to my house.  I could not be more excited and will highly recommend them to everyone who is interested.  The follow up service is all I hoped for.  Thank you Jaryd.

Thankyou Jaryd, (Oslec Energy) you made it a lot easier than I thought it would be.From the quoting and organising, right down to installation.I couldnt have asked for better.Even afterwards connecting me to the internet on the inverter.Thankyou for trimming the tree to stop the shade overhanging the solar panels.Definitely recommend your company to anyone.11 out of 10

Oslec was the only company that bothered getting onto my roof to measure before quoting. The guy doing the measure and quote was the guy doing the design and managing the installation.They listed to what my energy needs were and my desire to run more home automation, and my partner's fussiness on  appearance and symmetry, and provided some options and advice regarding the system design.Cheerfully worked around and coordinated with other trades as I was having my tiled roof repaired at the same time and to get the best outcome they put in the tile hooks for the racking before the roof was restored, so it looks even better. For the installation they also worked around wet weather and my household being Covid+ which delayed things unavoidably.The installation is extremely tidy with no rats nest of wiring. Racking and conduit very neat even with end caps on the racks to keep animals out. The GoodWe 10kW 3-phase inverter is neatly lined up with my meter box with all wiring in the wall cavity.With the monitoring system I can see what power I generate, consume and return to grid at all times, and this data means I can run home automation so I use appliances when I have the power to do so.Cannot recommend Jaryd, Simon and team highly enough.
